title: NOVARC LAUNCHES NovAI AUTONOMY AS PART OF NovAI SUITE AND EXPANDS INTEGRATION TO YASKAWA AND ABB ROBOTS
summary: Novarc is adding NovAI Autonomy to its NovAI Suite, bringing machine vision and real-time adaptation into robotic welding so systems can adjust during the weld rather than just execute fixed paths. The launch also extends Novarc’s NovHub Enterprise Welding Intelligence platform to ABB and Yaskawa robots, making its monitoring and analytics stack available across more industrial welding cells.

extra.full_text: At the show, Novarc will unveil NovAI™ Autonomy, an advanced solution that brings machine vision and real-time adaptation to robotic welding; and NovHub™ - the company’s Enterprise Welding Intelligence platform - on ABB and Yaskawa robots.

title: KRISO, 수심 3500m급 심해 코어시추·환경감시 통합 무인체계 개발 착수
summary: KRISO has launched a government R&D project to build an integrated unmanned deep-sea exploration system by 2030, centered on a remotely operated vehicle for core drilling at depths of 3,500 meters and an autonomous underwater vehicle for monitoring environmental impacts. The effort brings together nine institutions, including RedOne Technology, Hanjin D&B, Seoul National University, and KAIST, and matters because it links resource sampling with in-situ environmental surveillance in the same deep-ocean operating concept.

title: 노타·오케스트로, 국토부 6109억 '천안·아산 AI 도시 구축 사업' 선정
summary: Cheonan and Asan were selected for South Korea’s Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport AI-specialized pilot city program, a five-year project worth about 610.9 billion won through 2030. The 11-member consortium, including Upstage, Nota, Okestro, Ditonic, Clobot, KEPCO KDN, and KAIST’s Mobility AX Research Institute, will build an integrated urban intelligence center and test autonomous AI agent services for disaster response, traffic, and civil complaints.
